note: Packs whose label a person has checked. Normally a check is evidence about the open-data record (Open Food Facts) the catalogue uses, never a new source of figures. Exception, approved by the founder on 2026-10-16: a 'label_draft' adds a pack that has no open-data record, with the per-100 figures read from its label photo (kept under 'evidence'); it enters as a draft, through the same builder validation, until a nutritionist checks it. 'open_data_lookup' points to an open-data record fetched by barcode (catalogue_build/off_lookups) when the bulk export lacks it. 'shop_names' are the names shops show for the same pack; the database looks them up as aliases. 'saturated_fat_declared_zero' records that the pack declares 0 g saturated fat per serving with a stated %RDA, so the builder may keep the record's 0 when the colour is the same at 0 and at the bound the %RDA allows (curate_swaps.declared_zero_settles). 'record_disagrees' notes a listed record that differs from the pack, for the nutritionist.
